text: {"lessons":["My account is still about 6% below its starting value despite the recent rebound, so I should assess performance over the full period rather than focus on the latest gain.","Doing nothing avoids impulsive trades, but it does not reduce exposure; I should review whether my holdings and risk remain appropriate.","Given how much losses weigh on me, I should make measured, deliberate decisions that account for downside risk rather than chase short-term moves."]}
